name: smwmusic-pok-mon-gold-silver-crystal-game-corner-pok-gear-radio-lucky-channel
title: Pokémon Gold/Silver/Crystal - Game Corner / Pokégear Radio: Lucky Channel
description:
A port of the Game Corner and Lucky Channel's theme, in a true techno fashion.

This song is among my favorites from the Pokémon games, and since no one ported it yet (to my knowledge), I decided to port it myself!

This was also my first port to use pitch modulation. It was really fun to explore and see what kind of stuff I can do with it.

Can fit in abstract areas and other sorts of futuristic, techno-y places.

Update: Increased accuracy.
Update 2: Lowered insert size, and slightly improved readability.
